title: Publication
description: A book put out on one store, and what that store calls it. An edge between a title and a platform: the same book on three stores is three of these, each with its own listing, its own state and its own rate.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

book.description: The id of the book being put out, in the system that holds the book.

platform.description: Where it is being put out. Manual is for a channel nobody here talks to, recorded so the title's whereabouts stay complete.

status.description: Where the listing stands on that store. Read from the store, not decided here.

externalId.description: What the store calls this listing — its ASIN, its product id. The only handle the store will answer to.

listingUrl.description: The page a reader buys it on.

royaltyRate.description: The author's share, as a fraction: 0.7 is seventy per cent. A fraction and not a percentage so nobody has to guess which was meant.

estimatedMonthlyRoyalty.description: What this listing is expected to pay in a month, in the currency the store settles in. An estimate carried for planning, never an amount owed.

notes.description: Anything about this listing worth writing down, in the words of whoever put it out.

submittedAt.description: When it was sent to the store, which is not when the store accepted it.

publishedAt.description: When the listing went live on the store.
